title: Plane wave on a dielectric sphere (εr = 4, radius 5 mm) at 10 GHz: scattering and radar cross-sections
source: The Mie series for a sphere of size parameter ka = 1.047 and index 2: the coefficients aₙ, bₙ and amplitudes S₁, S₂ (C. F. Bohren, D. R. Huffman, Absorption and Scattering of Light by Small Particles, Wiley 1983, §4.4), evaluated by emcraft-theory (which meets their BHMIE listing to 1e-5); σ = 4π|S₂|²/k² in the E-plane, 4π|S₁|²/k² in the H-plane

quantities.reason: the scattered power through the Huygens box; six second-order elements per wavelength in each material (1.9 mm in the ceramic), the sphere's surface curved, a 12 mm layer: +0.6 % (+0.08 % at eight per wavelength with a 15 mm layer)

quantities.quantity: radar cross-section at θ = 90° in the E-plane (mm², near the dipole null)
quantities.reason: a weak lobe, 16 dB below the forward one: −1.6 %

quantities.quantity: radar cross-section at θ = 90° in the H-plane (mm²)
